data.one_liner: An extended Flutter Wrap widget that supports limiting row numbers and overflow widgets.
data.what_it_does: Extends the official Flutter Wrap widget to build special layouts such as limiting the maximum number of rows. It supports properties like maxLines, minLines, and an overflowWidget for stowing and expanding content.
use_when: You need a Wrap widget that limits the number of rows displayed.
You want to provide a stow and expand overflow widget inside a wrap layout.
avoid_when: Standard Flutter Wrap functionality without line limits is sufficient.
You need complex grid layouts with strict column counts.
strengths: Allows setting maxLines and minLines on a wrap layout.
Supports an overflowWidget for expand and stow functionality.
Works similarly to the official Flutter wrap.
weaknesses: Very sparse documentation and feature set described in the README.
